date_note: The page gives only its publication day (23 November) for Next's statement; it states no earlier day for the incident.
title: Next says an external online service provider it uses suffered a cyber incident
geo_basis: country only; the article gives no city for the provider or the company
summary: Calcalist, citing Reuters, reports that British retailer Next said an external online service provider it uses suffered a cyber incident, after which there was unauthorised access to some information linked to Next. According to Next, its own systems were not breached, the information is not sensitive and no personal customer data appears to have been obtained at this stage. Next says it is working with the provider, law enforcement and regulators.
plain: Next says a cyber incident hit an outside online service provider it uses. Next says its own systems were not breached and no personal customer data appears to have been obtained at this stage.
exec: Next says a supplier incident allowed unauthorised access to some information linked to the retailer; Next says it is not sensitive.

validation.note: One publisher read (Calcalist, relaying Reuters and Next's statement). The statement itself and the Reuters report were not read; the article links no company statement.

review.note: stronger than the source: removed 'hackers' and 'exposed'; source says unauthorised access to non-sensitive information; Next's statements, date, Reuters citation checked against Calcalist
